########################################
#
# Script contains the clone overlap between matching spAIRR (S1_ONT_Q17)
# and corresponding bulk-BCR dataset
#
# Joint clone annotation into scatter figure shown in pbpr response
#
########################################

Comparison of jointly assigned IGH clones in matched spatial and bulk libraries.
Counts represent retained molecular groups, not reads or cells. Spatial counts
use UMI–SPBC groups; bulk counts use UMIs, following the original analysis.
All spatial barcodes are included: this is a whole-library comparison.

```{r settings}
library(tidyverse)
library(scoper)
library(ggrepel)

SPATIAL_BCR_AIRR_PATH <- "~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp12_ont_sd17_af5/airr/ig_p_parse-select.tsv"
BULK_BCR_AIRR_PATH <- "~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/immcantation_analysis/2_results_3.2/r15/simplex_duplex/sample_demux/UID14/airr/ig_p_parse-select.tsv"

MIN_CONSENSUS_COUNT <- 2L # At least two supporting reads; set to 3L for consensus_count > 2
CLONE_THRESHOLD <- 0.15
NPROC <- 8
LABEL_SHARED_CLONES <- 8
BULK_MOLECULE_COLUMN <- "umi" # Retained from the original bulk comparison

# Match the constant-region categories retained in the Figure 6 analysis.
IGH_CONSTANT_GENES <- c("IGHA1", "IGHA2", "IGHG1", "IGHG2", "IGHG3", "IGHG4", "IGHM")
CLONE_COLORS <- c("Shared" = "#4C78A8", "spAIRR only" = "#F58518", "Bulk only" = "#54A24B")
```


Read productive AIRR tables and apply the same downstream QC to both libraries

```{r read-and-filter}
read_igh <- function(path, dataset_name, molecule_column, constant_column, constant_genes) {
  read_tsv(path.expand(path), show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) %>%
    select(-any_of(c("x", "y"))) %>%
    mutate(dataset = dataset_name, molecule_id = .data[[molecule_column]],
           sequence_id = paste(dataset_name, sequence_id, sep = "|"),
           consensus_count = as.integer(consensus_count),
           junction_length = as.integer(junction_length),
           umi = toupper(umi), junction = toupper(junction),
           constant_annotation = str_remove(.data[[constant_column]], "\\*.*$"),
           v_region_sequence = str_sub(toupper(sequence),
             start = as.integer(v_sequence_start), end = as.integer(v_sequence_end))) %>%
    filter(locus == "IGH", productive %in% c("T", "TRUE", "True", "true", "1"),
           !is.na(molecule_id), molecule_id != "",
           !is.na(constant_annotation), str_sub(constant_annotation, 1, 3) == locus,
           constant_annotation %in% constant_genes,
           !is.na(umi), umi != "", !str_detect(umi, "TTTTTTTTTTT"),
           !is.na(junction), junction != "", !str_detect(junction, "N"),
           !is.na(v_region_sequence), v_region_sequence != "", !str_detect(v_region_sequence, "N"),
           consensus_count >= MIN_CONSENSUS_COUNT)
}

spatial_igh <- read_igh(SPATIAL_BCR_AIRR_PATH, "spAIRR", "group",
                        "c_call", IGH_CONSTANT_GENES)

bulk_igh <- read_igh(BULK_BCR_AIRR_PATH, "Bulk", BULK_MOLECULE_COLUMN,
                     "isotype", c("IGHA", "IGHG", "IGHM"))


igh_combined <- bind_rows(spatial_igh, bulk_igh) %>%
  arrange(v_call, j_call, junction_length, junction, dataset, molecule_id)
```

Assign clones jointly, threshold 0.15

```{r joint-clones}
igh_joint_clones <- scoper::hierarchicalClones(igh_combined,
  method = "nt", linkage = "single", normalize = "len", first = FALSE,
  threshold = CLONE_THRESHOLD, verbose = FALSE, nproc = NPROC) %>%
  mutate(clone_id_joint = as.character(clone_id))
```

Count distinct molecular identifiers within each dataset and jointly assigned clone

```{r clone-counts}
clone_counts <- igh_joint_clones %>%
  distinct(dataset, clone_id_joint, molecule_id) %>%
  count(dataset, clone_id_joint, name = "n_molecules") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = n_molecules,
              values_fill = 0, names_prefix = "n_molecules_") %>%
  mutate(shared_clone = n_molecules_spAIRR > 0 & n_molecules_Bulk > 0,
         clone_status = case_when(shared_clone ~ "Shared",
                                  n_molecules_spAIRR > 0 ~ "spAIRR only",
                                  TRUE ~ "Bulk only"),
         clone_status = factor(clone_status, levels = names(CLONE_COLORS)),
         total_molecules = n_molecules_spAIRR + n_molecules_Bulk)

clone_overlap_summary <- clone_counts %>%
  summarise(n_spatial_clones = sum(n_molecules_spAIRR > 0),
            n_bulk_clones = sum(n_molecules_Bulk > 0),
            n_shared_clones = sum(shared_clone), n_union_clones = n()) %>%
  mutate(fraction_spatial_clones_shared = n_shared_clones / n_spatial_clones,
         fraction_bulk_clones_shared = n_shared_clones / n_bulk_clones)

shared_molecule_summary <- clone_counts %>%
  select(shared_clone, n_molecules_spAIRR, n_molecules_Bulk) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("n_molecules_"), names_to = "dataset",
               names_prefix = "n_molecules_", values_to = "n_molecules") %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(molecules_in_shared_clones = sum(n_molecules[shared_clone]),
            n_molecules = sum(n_molecules), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(fraction_molecules_in_shared_clones = molecules_in_shared_clones / n_molecules)

clone_overlap_summary
shared_molecule_summary
```

Each point represents a joint clone. Point area encodes the combined molecular
count

```{r scatter, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
shared_labels <- clone_counts %>%
  filter(shared_clone) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_molecules), clone_id_joint) %>%
  slice_head(n = LABEL_SHARED_CLONES)

axis_counts <- c(0, 1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000)

p_spatial_bulk_clone_abundance <- ggplot(clone_counts,
  aes(x = n_molecules_spAIRR + 1, y = n_molecules_Bulk + 1)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = clone_status, size = total_molecules),
             shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.25, alpha = 0.8) +
  #geom_text_repel(data = shared_labels, aes(label = clone_id_joint),
  #                size = 2, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = axis_counts + 1, labels = scales::comma(axis_counts)) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = axis_counts + 1, labels = scales::comma(axis_counts)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CLONE_COLORS, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 7) +
  labs(x = "spAIRR IGH molecules per clone", y = "Bulk IGH molecules per clone",
       fill = "Clone overlap", size = "Combined\nmolecules") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(order = 1), fill = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
        panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5), legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))

#p_spatial_bulk_clone_abundance
```

clone_counts %>%
  mutate(rank_spatial = min_rank(desc(n_molecules_spAIRR)),
         rank_bulk = min_rank(desc(n_molecules_Bulk))) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_molecules)) %>%
  select(clone_id_joint, n_molecules_spAIRR, n_molecules_Bulk,
         rank_spatial, rank_bulk) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)
